fast_carrier_OOB.note: Role mix is a working center, not a claim that every deck has the same group. CVLs are fighter/TBM heavy; the surviving branch Wasp CV-7 has been modernized into the contemporary F6F/TBM/SB2C-era operating system rather than retaining a 1942 air group.

14Jun_rotation.state: Two fast-carrier task groups refuel/rearm in rotation while the remaining groups sustain Marianas suppression and fleet CAP. The full 16-deck force exists, but not all decks are launching over Saipan simultaneously.

surface.Lee_fast_battleships: Seven fast battleships remain intact and available; no branch campaign-out has yet reduced TG58.7.
surface.Oldendorf_close_support: Seven older battleships plus cruisers/destroyers enter close bombardment on 14 Jun. Their shore-bombardment training is materially better than the 13 Jun fast-battleship fire.
surface.branch_note: US surface strength has not paid a major hull loss in the 11-13 Jun shaping phase.
